units.summary: New helper that checks whether s.ooo is nil, pulled out of the old inline OOO check. It is used as the eviction and filter predicate.
units.headline: Extract OOO-absence check into isSeriesWithoutOOO helper
units.reason: Trivial predicate that is equivalent to the old inline check.

units.summary: The stale-NaN check over float, histogram and float-histogram last values moves out of gcStaleSeries and staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData into this helper. The logic is unchanged.
units.headline: Extract stale-NaN check into isStaleSeries helper
units.reason: Same expression as the removed inline code.

units.summary: Now delegates to truncateSeries with a predicate: no OOO data, still stale, and no appendID above the watermark. Before, it checked only staleness at GC time; the no-OOO and watermark conditions are new.
units.headline: Stale truncation now also requires no OOO and watermark check
units.reason: The eviction criteria changed, so fewer series may be deleted.
focus: Series that gained OOO data after the ref list was collected are now kept in the head; confirm this is intended
Watermark is captured before the block write

units.summary: New eviction path for CompactSelectedSeries. It removes the listed series unless they carry OOO data or have an appendID above the watermark.
units.headline: Add truncateSelectedSeries evicting arbitrary series without OOO data
units.reason: New code that deletes series from the head.
focus: With isolation disabled the watermark guard does nothing, so a late append can be lost (the PR's own test shows this)

units.summary: Walks the series' txRing looking for an appendID above the watermark, and returns false when isolation is disabled. The 'always returns false' claim holds: the function returns early whenever s.txs is nil.
units.headline: Add appendID watermark check to guard eviction against late appends
units.reason: This guard decides whether late samples survive eviction.
focus: The txRing may already have dropped older IDs; confirm late appendIDs are always still in the ring at check time
s.Lock must be held by the gcSeries caller

units.summary: The old truncateStaleSeries body is generalized: it takes a shouldEvict predicate and returns the count of evicted series. Locking and the WAL tombstone logic are unchanged.
units.headline: Generalize stale truncation into predicate-based truncateSeries
units.reason: Mechanical generalization; the eviction behavior itself lives in the predicates.

units.summary: Call site updated for the new watermark argument. Passing MaxUint64 disables the guard, so the test's expectations are unchanged.
units.headline: Pass MaxUint64 watermark to truncateStaleSeries in test
units.reason: Signature update only, in a test file.

units.summary: New test of filterSeriesAndSortPostings. It checks that a clean series is kept, a series with OOO data is skipped, and an unknown ref is dropped.
units.headline: Add test for filterSeriesAndSortPostings keep/skip/drop outcomes
units.reason: New test only.
